QuestInfo.name: The Start of Adventure
QuestInfo.2:
#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/501/0#
It began with a tree, a maple tree. As you left its comforting embrace, you sensed that an adventure beyond your wildest dreams loomed ahead. A Maple Leaf brushed your shoes, and you tucked it into your Explorer Book as a reminder of your origins. \r\n\r\nAnd so, your adventure began.
